blocks.title: F. My NIS route
paragraphs: NIS final school qualification should be identified accurately; do not label it generic Kazakhstan Attestat or claim a British A-level solely because NIS uses HL grades. The public NYUAD page permits school transcripts/predicted results and completion of secondary education before enrolment, but **specific NIS HL equivalence, International Qualifications Tool category and predicted-exam route are not publicly confirmed here**. Counselor should provide curriculum, grading scale, expected June graduation and official predictions.

No published NIS minimum number of HLs/grades or compulsory UNT for this route. June graduation can fit normal pre-enrolment submission, but **exact 2027 final diploma/ECE deadline is TBA**. NYUAD admitted page points international graduates to ECE; obtain its Kazakhstan/NIS instructions and whether university covers verification cost. Apostille is not a universal initial application requirement in checked NYUAD pages; ECE documentation may have its own verification rules.

English waiver requires **three consecutive academic years solely in English**, excluding foreign-language classes. A multilingual NIS curriculum does not automatically qualify because STEM is taught in English. Ask about actual school years and language of every subject. [Entry requirements](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/apply/entry-requirements.html).

blocks.title: Official minima / competitive target
paragraphs: Secondary education completion, age 17 byAug 1 and rigorous academic preparation apply. Numeric NIS GPA/HL admission minimum and official competitive range for NYUAD CS/CE are **not published**. Recommended calculus / strong mathematics is not a numerical admission cutoff. Scholarship is need-based, not a published SAT-trigger merit tier.

blocks.title: SAT / ACT / AP / IB
paragraphs: **Test-optional through the 2027–28 application cycle**, covering this Fall 2027 application. SAT/ACT not required. SAT minimum/Math threshold and guaranteed scholarship benefit not published. Flexible external qualifications may be submitted; the appropriate NIS category must be confirmed, not substituted with unearned IB/AP/A-level. Exact campus-wide superscore and all report codes should be checked in NYU instructions when opting into tests; no reason to send paid reports to a guessed NYUAD-only code. SAT/ACT recipient codes для NYUAD в этой проверке **не подтверждены**; перед платным заказом использовать current NYU portal instructions.

blocks.title: English
paragraphs: English required absent waiver; IELTS Academic / TOEFL / DET routes were listed in the prior audit and NYU-wide information. **NYUAD public entry page does not publish a numerical minimum or individual bands.** Do not transfer NYU SPS, Wagner or Liberal Studies competitive targets to NYUAD minimums. PTE/Cambridge/iTEP, Home Edition and One Skill Retake applicability should be confirmed on current undergraduate testing instructions if chosen.

Official sister-campus reporting guidance states undergraduate English reception is shared across NYU: TOEFL **2562**, IELTS **New York University Undergraduate** (US), DET **New York University — New York, undergraduate**. It instructs both self-report and agency report. This supports shared routing but is **Tier 1 cross-campus reference**, not a new NYUAD 2027 arrival-deadline policy. [Official NYU Shanghai reporting instructions](https://apply.shanghai.nyu.edu/knowledgebase/article/KA-01006/zh-cn). English tests should be within 2 years per NYUAD entry rule; confirm validity date relative to application. Latest safe test: **November 2026 for RD**, internal recommendation; official late-result grace TBA.

blocks.title: H. Internal exam / interview / Candidate Weekend
paragraphs: No published compulsory CS programming/math admission exam for all applicants. **Candidate Weekend** is a shortlisted assessment requirement for invited applicants who have not already attended under applicable conditions. Includes discussions/activities/interviews; no public scored rubric, weight or timed exam syllabus. Invitation confirmation **within 48 hours**. Missing an invitation cannot be solved by assuming a later round; exceptional deferral needs office approval.

University covers **CW travel, visa, accommodation and meals**, not parents’ travel. CW passport needs validity 6 months after event and processing readiness; pre-travel passport submission instructions apply. Funded CW participation is not a four-year scholarship award. [Current 2026–27 Candidate Weekend](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/apply/selection-process/candidate-weekend.html).

blocks.title: I. Recommendations — number, authors, form and strategy
paragraphs: NYUAD specific checklist: **one letter**; author may be teacher, counselor, adviser or another person able to discuss academic/personal potential. Teacher letter strongest for this CS/AI profile if it gives intellectual depth and real project/classroom evidence. Counselor handles school records regardless of chosen author; no published required second teacher or separate scholarship letter.

**Official-page contradiction:** [Common App NYU profile](https://www.commonapp.org/explore/new-york-university/) shows generic “No letter of recommendation required — First Year”; [NYUAD Apply](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/apply.html) explicitly asks one. Use NYUAD-specific requirement and ask office/live application to resolve the displayed discrepancy. Do not mark letter absent based on the generic tag.

Submission: author receives Common App invitation and submits the recommendation; permitted school/author hard-copy alternative only under NYU instructions. Exact current rating questions, character/word limits and whether author also completes optional Common App evaluations are **not publicly verified**. A counselor brag sheet is not the official letter form.

**My strategy:** one Math/Physics/CS teacher with concrete examples; ask 5–7 October and prepare evidence sheet by 10 October. Do not send multiple unsolicited letters as though they were requirements. Internal final letter target **15 November for RD**, ahead of Common App submission.

blocks.title: J. Essays — exact current task, limits and official wording discrepancy
paragraphs: Three supplement angles in [official current-cycle article](https://meet.nyu.edu/advice/application-tips/your-guide-to-the-nyu-supplemental-essay/):

**Wording conflict:** NYUAD Apply presents a fuller version: second angle explicitly includes diverse backgrounds, group challenges and how they were overcome; third asks how the person responds to difficulties/disagreement. The current 2026–27 article is shorter. Both are official; **live NYU Common App wording must control**, without claiming the paraphrases above reproduce a single exact verified portal prompt. Limit 250 is confirmed; portal character/byte counters not published.

**Purpose — analysis:** ability to understand difference, connect and collaborate; not a generic achievements catalogue. Real project teamwork, volunteering, leadership or cross-perspective problem-solving may fit. Do not create a conflict, personal hardship or impact number that did not occur. Common App essay can develop a separate dimension rather than duplicate supplement.
lists: 1. Experience of meeting a different perspective; what you learned about yourself, the other person or the world.
2. Work with people of different perspectives; your role in helping the group work together and what you learned.
3. Observe someone who brings people together well; how they prepare common exploration and which qualities you admire.

# Batch 3 — 14. NYU Abu Dhabi

Last checked: **4 October 2026**. Applicant: Kazakhstan / Nazarbayev Intellectual School / Fall 2027 undergraduate. NYU New York, Shanghai и Abu Dhabi имеют общую application, но campus-specific rules нельзя смешивать.

## A. University snapshot

| Field | Verified finding |

| University / type | NYU Abu Dhabi (NYUAD); undergraduate liberal arts, sciences and engineering campus of NYU |
| Country / city / campus | UAE; Abu Dhabi; Saadiyat Island |

| Application platform | **Common App → New York University → Abu Dhabi primary campus**; затем NYU Applicant Portal, **STARS** и отдельный **NYUAD Applicant Profile** |
| Application URL | [Common App](https://apply.commonapp.org/); [NYUAD Apply](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/apply.html) |
| Best programmes / degree | **Computer Science (BS)**; **Computer Engineering (BS)** |
| Medium / major | English; university admission, затем выбор major и curricular progression. Точную дату declaration/перевод между majors сверить с academic adviser/catalogue |
| Age | ≥17 by **1 August** of entry year |
| Intake / acceptance rate | Current Fall 2027 international intake / acceptance rate not officially published |

Sources: [entry requirements](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/apply/entry-requirements.html), [CS bulletin](https://bulletins.nyu.edu/undergraduate/abu-dhabi/programs/computer-science-bs/), [CE bulletin](https://bulletins.nyu.edu/undergraduate/abu-dhabi/programs/computer-engineering-bs/).

## Changes since 13 Sep 2026

| Degrees | **Correction:** September stated BA Computer Science / BEng Computer Engineering. Official NYU Bulletin names **BS for both** |
| Supplement limit | **Correction:** previous audit said public article did not fix word limit. Official August 4, 2026 article confirms **optional, 250 words max** for the 2026–27 cycle |
| STARS / Profile | **Correction:** STARS is school-course/grade reporting; **NYUAD Applicant Profile is a separate required context form**. The previous audit merged the names and attributed context questions to STARS |
| Recommendations | NYUAD requires **one letter** from a person who can address university potential, not necessarily an academic teacher. Generic Common App profile displays “No letter … required”, a conflict with the more specific NYUAD checklist |
| Aid renewal | **Correction / clarification:** published policy is CSS once and renewal at the original aid level, subject to academic review; not annual reassessment of financial need |
| IDOC | Selected verification only, not universal upfront filing. Explicit 2027–28 instruction uses **2025 tax/income year** |
| Candidate Weekend | Current cycle dates verified; mandatory if invited and applicable. Not merely an optional generic interview |

Sources: [current supplement article](https://meet.nyu.edu/advice/application-tips/your-guide-to-the-nyu-supplemental-essay/), [Apply](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/apply.html), [aid overview](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/scholarships-and-financial-aid.html), [verification](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/scholarships-and-financial-aid/required-additional-documentation.html), [admitted students — Class 2030 reference](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/admitted-students.html).

## B. Programmes for me

| Exact name / degree | School / language | Academic preparation / entry | Fit |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Computer Science (BS)** | NYU Abu Dhabi, science programme; English | Quantitative preparation; calculus encouraged. Mathematics and CS courses in degree; no published NIS HL admission cutoff / mandatory prior coding credential | Algorithms, software, AI-related research and electives; strongest broad CS choice |
| **Computer Engineering (BS)** | NYU Abu Dhabi, engineering programme; English | Quantitative/science preparation; curriculum includes mathematics, electronics and hardware/software | Embedded / robotics / computational systems; choose if hardware interest is genuine |

Sources: [CS major](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/academics/undergraduate/majors-and-minors/computer-science-major.html), [CE major](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/academics/undergraduate/majors-and-minors/computer-engineering-major.html), [CS degree requirements](https://bulletins.nyu.edu/undergraduate/abu-dhabi/programs/computer-science-bs/), [CE requirements](https://bulletins.nyu.edu/undergraduate/abu-dhabi/programs/computer-engineering-bs/).

**Best programme for me:** CS, with CE as an alternative for embedded/robotics interests. No separately verified standalone AI, Software Engineering or Data Science undergraduate major in the checked listings. Physics and calculus in CE curriculum are not automatically a published high-school Physics HL grade requirement. Numeric major quota, major-specific full-aid rate and female international restrictions are not published. Changing intended major is not permission to ignore prerequisites or the degree graduation plan.

NYUAD dates page does not print the year beside every recurring deadline; this limitation is explicit rather than described as a new Fall 2027 guide.

**Binding:** ED I / ED II bind to the primary campus/programme offer if financing makes attendance possible; withdraw other applications after acceptance. Aid shortage can justify release under published policy; obtain a formal release rather than ignore agreement. Different primary-campus outcome can also affect obligation. **RD non-binding**. Admission denial under ED cannot be resubmitted to RD that year. RD is preferable if comparing funded offers is necessary.

### My recommended timeline — choose RD unless an affordable ED commitment is clear

| NIS school records + official qualification question | **10 October** |
| Common App essay first draft / NYU supplement | **15 October / 20 October** |

## D. Application platform and fee

Common App → select **New York University**, make **Abu Dhabi primary campus** if that is the intended offer. Up to two alternate NYU campuses can be listed; one resulting NYU admissions decision, not three unrelated applications. Applicant portal access normally 7–10 business days after Common App submission. **STARS** (self-reported academic record, free) and **NYUAD Applicant Profile** (additional context) are distinct required post-submission tasks. Use same email to match STARS and Common App. [Apply](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/apply.html).

Common App submitted application is not freely editable; updates and score/doc corrections go through NYU portal/instructions. School official uploads school materials, author letter separately. Public page permits unofficial copies for review but also requires official-source documents/scores for verification; confirm which English report must arrive before review rather than assume final-only certification covers all tests.

| Fee | Rule |
|---|---|
| NYU application | **USD 85, non-refundable** |
| Application waiver | Available for financial hardship through application waiver instructions; counselor verification if requested. International applicants can request; not automatically granted solely for NIS |
| CSS | **USD 25 first school; USD 16 each additional** |
| NYUAD CSS payment code | Limited, first-come-first-served; request from Oct 1 **after Common App submission and NYU portal activation** |
| IDOC | Separate applicant filing fee not stated on NYUAD page; do not pay a third-party agent |
| Admission / housing deposit | Current Class 2030 page says **none**; specific 2027 offer confirmation TBA |
| ECE diploma verification / translation / courier | Provider-dependent; cost and sponsorship for NIS not verified |

NYU application waiver and CSS payment code are two different requests.

## F. My NIS route

NIS final school qualification should be identified accurately; do not label it generic Kazakhstan Attestat or claim a British A-level solely because NIS uses HL grades. The public NYUAD page permits school transcripts/predicted results and completion of secondary education before enrolment, but **specific NIS HL equivalence, International Qualifications Tool category and predicted-exam route are not publicly confirmed here**. Counselor should provide curriculum, grading scale, expected June graduation and official predictions.

No published NIS minimum number of HLs/grades or compulsory UNT for this route. June graduation can fit normal pre-enrolment submission, but **exact 2027 final diploma/ECE deadline is TBA**. NYUAD admitted page points international graduates to ECE; obtain its Kazakhstan/NIS instructions and whether university covers verification cost. Apostille is not a universal initial application requirement in checked NYUAD pages; ECE documentation may have its own verification rules.

English waiver requires **three consecutive academic years solely in English**, excluding foreign-language classes. A multilingual NIS curriculum does not automatically qualify because STEM is taught in English. Ask about actual school years and language of every subject. [Entry requirements](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/apply/entry-requirements.html).

## G. Academic requirements, SAT/ACT and English

### Official minima / competitive target

Secondary education completion, age 17 byAug 1 and rigorous academic preparation apply. Numeric NIS GPA/HL admission minimum and official competitive range for NYUAD CS/CE are **not published**. Recommended calculus / strong mathematics is not a numerical admission cutoff. Scholarship is need-based, not a published SAT-trigger merit tier.

### SAT / ACT / AP / IB

**Test-optional through the 2027–28 application cycle**, covering this Fall 2027 application. SAT/ACT not required. SAT minimum/Math threshold and guaranteed scholarship benefit not published. Flexible external qualifications may be submitted; the appropriate NIS category must be confirmed, not substituted with unearned IB/AP/A-level. Exact campus-wide superscore and all report codes should be checked in NYU instructions when opting into tests; no reason to send paid reports to a guessed NYUAD-only code. SAT/ACT recipient codes для NYUAD в этой проверке **не подтверждены**; перед платным заказом использовать current NYU portal instructions.

### English

English required absent waiver; IELTS Academic / TOEFL / DET routes were listed in the prior audit and NYU-wide information. **NYUAD public entry page does not publish a numerical minimum or individual bands.** Do not transfer NYU SPS, Wagner or Liberal Studies competitive targets to NYUAD minimums. PTE/Cambridge/iTEP, Home Edition and One Skill Retake applicability should be confirmed on current undergraduate testing instructions if chosen.

Official sister-campus reporting guidance states undergraduate English reception is shared across NYU: TOEFL **2562**, IELTS **New York University Undergraduate** (US), DET **New York University — New York, undergraduate**. It instructs both self-report and agency report. This supports shared routing but is **Tier 1 cross-campus reference**, not a new NYUAD 2027 arrival-deadline policy. [Official NYU Shanghai reporting instructions](https://apply.shanghai.nyu.edu/knowledgebase/article/KA-01006/zh-cn). English tests should be within 2 years per NYUAD entry rule; confirm validity date relative to application. Latest safe test: **November 2026 for RD**, internal recommendation; official late-result grace TBA.

## H. Internal exam / interview / Candidate Weekend

No published compulsory CS programming/math admission exam for all applicants. **Candidate Weekend** is a shortlisted assessment requirement for invited applicants who have not already attended under applicable conditions. Includes discussions/activities/interviews; no public scored rubric, weight or timed exam syllabus. Invitation confirmation **within 48 hours**. Missing an invitation cannot be solved by assuming a later round; exceptional deferral needs office approval.

University covers **CW travel, visa, accommodation and meals**, not parents’ travel. CW passport needs validity 6 months after event and processing readiness; pre-travel passport submission instructions apply. Funded CW participation is not a four-year scholarship award. [Current 2026–27 Candidate Weekend](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/apply/selection-process/candidate-weekend.html).

## I. Recommendations — number, authors, form and strategy

NYUAD specific checklist: **one letter**; author may be teacher, counselor, adviser or another person able to discuss academic/personal potential. Teacher letter strongest for this CS/AI profile if it gives intellectual depth and real project/classroom evidence. Counselor handles school records regardless of chosen author; no published required second teacher or separate scholarship letter.

**Official-page contradiction:** [Common App NYU profile](https://www.commonapp.org/explore/new-york-university/) shows generic “No letter of recommendation required — First Year”; [NYUAD Apply](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/apply.html) explicitly asks one. Use NYUAD-specific requirement and ask office/live application to resolve the displayed discrepancy. Do not mark letter absent based on the generic tag.

Submission: author receives Common App invitation and submits the recommendation; permitted school/author hard-copy alternative only under NYU instructions. Exact current rating questions, character/word limits and whether author also completes optional Common App evaluations are **not publicly verified**. A counselor brag sheet is not the official letter form.

**My strategy:** one Math/Physics/CS teacher with concrete examples; ask 5–7 October and prepare evidence sheet by 10 October. Do not send multiple unsolicited letters as though they were requirements. Internal final letter target **15 November for RD**, ahead of Common App submission.

## J. Essays — exact current task, limits and official wording discrepancy

| Essay / form | Official task — precise Russian rendering, not verbatim quote | Limit / language | Required? | Submission |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Common App personal essay | Choose **one of seven 2026–27 prompts**; full structured paraphrases in final master essay appendix | Standard Common App **250–650 words**, English; 650 max confirmed in prior official UI material, current live counter must be checked | Prepare; NYU-specific live required toggle not inspected | Common App |
| **NYU 2026–27 supplement** | NYU seeks people who connect people/groups/ideas across divides and support understanding/collaboration. Address **one or more** of three angles below | **≤250 words**, English; optional | **O** | NYU questions in Common App |
| NYUAD Applicant Profile | Additional academic/personal context; exact current questions not public | **Portal-only / not verified** | **R** | After submission via NYU portal |
| STARS | Academic courses and grades, not an essay | Fields / no essay prompt | **R** | STARS |
| CSS / IDOC explanation | Financial forms; circumstances explanation only if requested | Form-specific | Conditional | CSS / IDOC / aid office |
| Separate merit / scholarship essay or video | Not a universal international NYUAD aid item | Not published | Not verified as R | Do not invent |

Three supplement angles in [official current-cycle article](https://meet.nyu.edu/advice/application-tips/your-guide-to-the-nyu-supplemental-essay/):

1. Experience of meeting a different perspective; what you learned about yourself, the other person or the world.
2. Work with people of different perspectives; your role in helping the group work together and what you learned.
3. Observe someone who brings people together well; how they prepare common exploration and which qualities you admire.

**Wording conflict:** NYUAD Apply presents a fuller version: second angle explicitly includes diverse backgrounds, group challenges and how they were overcome; third asks how the person responds to difficulties/disagreement. The current 2026–27 article is shorter. Both are official; **live NYU Common App wording must control**, without claiming the paraphrases above reproduce a single exact verified portal prompt. Limit 250 is confirmed; portal character/byte counters not published.

**Purpose — analysis:** ability to understand difference, connect and collaborate; not a generic achievements catalogue. Real project teamwork, volunteering, leadership or cross-perspective problem-solving may fit. Do not create a conflict, personal hardship or impact number that did not occur. Common App essay can develop a separate dimension rather than duplicate supplement.

## K. Scholarships / Financial Aid, coverage, renewal, housing and gap

### Aid categories and applications

| Category | Applicable finding |
|---|---|
| A. Automatic admission merit | No universal Kazakh applicant automatic full ride published |
| B. Separate entry merit | No separate international merit full-ride form confirmed in checked NYUAD sources |
| C. **NYUAD need-based aid** | All nationalities can seek institutional aid; CSS required at entry. Individual award, not a blanket 100%COA guarantee for every admit |
| D. Emirati scholarship | Government-supported route for eligible Emirati citizenship/parent categories; not ordinary Kazakhstan citizen route |

CSS code **2785**, all NYU campuses. Parent households: both custodial and noncustodial if applicable; noncustodial waiver is a distinct signed request with supporting evidence sent to **ncpwaiver@nyu.edu**, by relevant deadline. **Not via IDOC**. Missing entry aid deadlines may prevent later access; file on time rather than treat it as an after-offer request. No published SAT/IELTS merit tier, scholarship count or official award percentage. [Apply for aid](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/scholarships-and-financial-aid/apply-for-financial-aid.html).

### Financial evidence and verification

IDOC is **selected verification after invitation**. Current page explicitly instructs academic year **2027–28**. For non-US families it lists cover page, Earner Income Form and **2025** foreign tax returns in English; if no return, employer-signed income evidence or 2025 salary statements and benefits. Both relevant parental households and student documentation may be requested. Substantial 2026 income change should be disclosed with supporting records. [2027–28 verification](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/apply/undergraduate/scholarships-and-financial-aid/required-additional-documentation.html).

**Form-version issue:** linked [Earner Income PDF](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/content/dam/nyuad/admissions/undergraduate/documents/nyuad-css-profile-income-verification.pdf) при повторном открытии действительно показывает 2026–27 и 2024 income, while current page requires 2027–28/2025. Verify downloaded form heading against the requested year before completing; ask aid office for correct form if mismatch remains. Do not submit old-year form without clarification.

### Funding coverage — individual award, not guaranteed minimum
